scripts.deploy: prisma db push --accept-data-loss && npm run seed
scripts.db:setup: npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && npx prisma generate && npm run seed
scripts.db:fresh: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const p=path.join('prisma','dev.db');['prisma/dev.db','prisma/dev.db-journal',p,p+'-journal'].forEach(f=>{try{fs.unlinkSync(f)}catch(e){}})" && npm run db:setup
